spec: Implement module edge_detector(input wire clk, rst, din, output reg pulse). All state changes only on rising clk. rst is active-high synchronous and has priority. State before the first reset edge is unspecified. Register din history and output pulse. On rst both history and pulse=0. Otherwise pulse is 1 for this cycle iff current sampled din=1 and previous sampled din=0. Update history each rising edge.
